'''Lanthanide''' was a metallic substance used in [[Armor/Legends|armor]] plating. It could be made into an alloy with [[Duralium/Legends|duralium]]. It was used in the exterior shell armor of the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] and in [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Chair of Office/Legends|Chair of Office]].
